newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR LEICESTER V MIDDLESBROUGH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR LEICESTER V MIDDLESBROUGH.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's English League Cup final replay between Leicester and Middlesbrough at Hillsborough:

Leicester: 13-Kasey Keller, 2-Simon Grayson, 3-Mike Whitlow, 5-Steve Walsh (captain), 17-Spencer Prior, 15-Pontus Kaamark, 6-Muzzy Izzet, 7-Neil Lennon, 10-Gary Parker, 9-Steve Claridge, 11-Emile Heskey.

Middlesbrough: 25-Ben Roberts, 2-Neil Cox, 5-Nigel Pearson (captain), 18-Gianluca Festa, 7-Vladimir Kinder, 8-Robbie Mustoe, 21-Craig Hignett, 17-Clayton Blackmore, 6-Emerson, 10-Juninho, 11-Fabrizio Ravanelli.
